A seen String-to-Data identity map detects canonically equal names with different UTF-8 before adding the current entry to the result. Same-byte duplicates deliberately keep the last value; malformed maps fail explicitly. previewVariableMap and Host small changes both use this guard.
v1FindingClosure.persistedNestedMaps: readPreview invokes validateRecordMaps before JSONDecoder<PreviewRecord>. The bounded fixed-field navigator examines raw bookLargeVariables, chapterVariables and chapterLargeVariables leaf maps before outer dictionary decoding. Chapter-state outer names must be canonical Base64 encodings of nonempty bounded UTF-8 URLs; embedded DTO variable String maps are checked again by the ordinary record validation.
v1FindingClosure.companionAccess: Both read and commit use exactValue to compare the actual stored key UTF-8 before returning, overwriting or deleting a canonically equivalent key. Candidate writes, persisted-record validation and UI projections validateRepresentable across the small/companion maps before merge, so an alias cannot silently replace a value during projection.
